content:
Post 1

📈 Consumer names dragged the ASX higher Friday while tech sold off — classic late-cycle rotation. ASX 200 closed at 8,908.10, up 0.18%, hitting a 20-day high. Still 4.18% off the 52-week peak. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🟢 Consumer Discretionary led all sectors, up 2.73%. Industrials +1.14%, Energy +0.97%. On the other side, IT dropped 1.34%, Consumer Staples -0.97%, Materials -0.87%. Spending beats saving on the ASX today. #ASX #ausbiz #consumerDiscretionary

Post 3

JBH surged 6.21% to AUD 72.88, adding AUD 4.26 on the day. REH topped the index at +8.44%. Two consumer names dominating the leaderboard on the same session tells you where the conviction sat today. #ASX #retail #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,689.83/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7029. Silver AUD 72.62/oz, Platinum AUD 2,060.35/oz. Metals priced firm in local terms — a weaker Aussie dollar doing quiet work in the background. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

ASX sits 4.18% below its 52-week high with momentum building — 1.28% gained over five days. Can Consumer Discretionary hold the lead into next week, or does IT snap back? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
